description: Import a stock candidate (candidateId from search_resources) into a project as an ORG-OWNED media item — provider/externalId/license provenance preserved, bytes deduped across orgs. Pass projectId + candidateId. Returns { id, status:"importing"|"ready" }; processing is async — call wait_job(kind="media", id=mediaItemId), then use the returned id as a composition source. Gated on the resource_import plan feature (402 billing_required if your plan lacks it). COST: 0 credits — search and import are both free for a keyed caller (get_account → entitlements.resource_import.listUsdPerUnit is 0); imported bytes count toward the storage gauge. 422 candidate_mismatch if the candidate expired — re-run search_resources.

body.description: POST /resources/import body — stock candidate lane { projectId, candidateId } OR curated pack lane { kind:"sfx-pack"|"music-pack", id }.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.
